purpose: Require every shipped feature/responsibility to be audited for reality, utility, correctness, canonical ownership, intelligence fit, stale/duplicate code, maintainability, cleanup/rewrite need, assurance ownership and closure readiness.

tenOutOfTenSemantics.rule: Every applicable dimension must pass or be explicitly not applicable with rationale; serious gaps cannot be averaged away.

conditionalFeatureFields.dataTruthAssessment: Required for provider, market-data, evidence, freshness, authority, fallback and derived-intelligence responsibilities.
conditionalFeatureFields.securityRightsAssessment: Required for role, session, secret, provider-rights, identity, export/import, privileged control and external egress responsibilities.
conditionalFeatureFields.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: Required for durable state, cache/checkpoint, profile, identity/session, workspace, migration, install, restart and packaged lifecycle responsibilities.
conditionalFeatureFields.performanceEfficiencyAssessment: Required for runtime loops, provider calls, fan-out, background jobs, rendering at scale, queues, concurrency and expensive workflows.
conditionalFeatureFields.observabilityAssessment: Required when failures/degradation/health/entitlement/load/rights states must be distinguishable.
conditionalFeatureFields.correctiveIssue: Required when closureDecision requires blocking remediation.

permanentBoundaries.noMaximalIntelligenceBias: Deterministic responsibilities must not be made adaptive merely to appear smarter.
permanentBoundaries.noStyleOnlyRewrite: REWRITE requires a concrete correctness, ownership, safety, maintainability, performance or evolution reason and executable equivalence protection.
permanentBoundaries.noAgeOnlyDeletion: Old-looking code cannot be removed without current consumer/reachability/equivalence evidence.
